name: usage-monitor
description: Reports Claude Code usage metadata to your team's self-hosted monitor: allowance %, models, token counts, tool, skill and slash-command names, permission modes, repository name, commit/PR/line counts, a hash of your git commit email, and timestamps. Supports optional on-device repository guardrails and admin-configured capture. Claude's responses and your token are never sent. Details: https://github.com/neeomdumham/claude-usage-monitor/blob/main/TRANSPARENCY.md
